等待查询
views.script: document.getElementById('run-query').addEventListener('click',async()=>{ const state=document.getElementById('state');state.textContent='正在查询…';try{const rows=await toolhub.call('registry.search',{query:document.getElementById('query').value,limit:5});const root=document.getElementById('results');root.replaceChildren();rows.slice(0,5).forEach(row=>{const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='row';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=row.name;const path=document.createElement('code');path.textContent=row.path;item.append(title,path);root.append(item)});state.textContent=`找到 ${rows.length} 条结果，最多显示 5 条`;}catch(e){state.textContent=e.message}})
